what_it_does: Pulls a Docker image with sudo docker, saves it as a gzip tarball, uploads the tarball to the project cache, and returns the uploaded file ID.

decisions.label: a
decisions.why: The pull is the only source of image layers when the image is absent locally, and for a mutable tag it refreshes the local copy so the saved tarball matches the registry. Skipping it when a local copy exists would upload a stale tag, which changes the file written, and for digest-pinned refs the skipped work is one manifest request beside a save, gzip and upload that still run.

what_it_does: Syntax-checks the entry point, the bootstrap scripts and every file under resources, and warns about resource files that fail.

decisions.label: a
decisions.why: Passing the enforce flag through would stop the DXSyntaxError raise, which removes the files-with-problems warning under the no-check-syntax option, and skipping the call would also remove the per-file error lines printed by the check. Both are printed output, and the work saved is a py_compile per resource .py file and a bash -n per .sh file, which is small local CPU.

what_it_does: Checks an app or applet source tree, chooses build projects by region, uploads resources and the executable, and creates or returns the app or applet.

decisions.label: a
decisions.why: On the applet branch with a destination, the region of the same working project is described at line 793 and again at line 845 inside a try block. When the second project equals the one already described, the second call can reuse the region from the first, which yields the same region and projects_by_region, and the first call already raises before the second could run. The removed call is one identical API request per applet build with a destination.

what_it_does: Warns when dxapp.json suggestions name projects, folders or objects that are missing or not public, and raises when a suggested object is absent.

decisions.label: a
decisions.why: Each suggestion with a project sends its own project describe, so a project named by several inputs is described repeatedly. A per-call memo keyed by project and the permissions flag, holding either the response or the DXAPIError, keeps every warning and every exception path the same, and the saving is a few API round trips per build.

decisions.label: b
decisions.why: The describe call is the existence test that raises on a 404, so only the unused assignment could be removed, which saves nothing, and removing the call would drop the error.

decisions.label: c
decisions.why: Each suggestion with a path issues its own folder listing, so repeated project and path pairs repeat the request. Memoizing the outcome per pair, including a ResolutionError that is re-raised unchanged, keeps the warning and abort behaviour identical.

what_it_does: Routes a build to the Nextflow path, the build-from-applet path, a local build, or a remote build, and returns or prints the executable ID.

decisions.label: a
decisions.why: The list in the any call holds two items and is_importer_job reads one small local JSON file, each once per invocation, so the energy at stake is microseconds.

what_it_does: Creates a temporary applet directory, copies the template tree into it, and writes the generated dxapp.json, source script and readme.

decisions.label: a
decisions.why: The copied dxapp.json and src/nextflow.sh are overwritten later, but copy2 keeps the template mode on src/nextflow.sh, while a file created fresh by the write call gets a umask-dependent mode, so the file written changes. The saving is a 42 KB local copy.

what_it_does: Checks that the version asset files and the project ID files parse, hold well-formed IDs, and list the same regions in prod and staging.

decisions.label: a
decisions.why: The premise fails, because versions.json names distinct files for 24.10 and 25.10, so no asset file is processed twice, and each file is about 600 bytes.

what_it_does: Returns the alphabetically first regular file in a directory whose name matches a readme pattern, or None.

decisions.label: a
decisions.why: The re module caches compiled patterns, so compile is a cache lookup, and the stat calls run once per build over the top-level entries, which costs microseconds.

what_it_does: Runs the interactive app wizard, printing instance-type tables and prompting for app settings, and fills in the app spec.

decisions.label: a
decisions.why: It runs once per interactive session on a table of preferred types, so the list it builds costs microseconds next to the user typing.

what_it_does: Lists the folders and objects at a path or the matched entities, printing names, IDs, or long-form descriptions.

decisions.label: a
decisions.why: The folder-path Counter at line 815 is already gated on brief and verbose, and the unconditional Counter at line 827 is one pass of dictionary increments over the matched results, microseconds per entry, which is small next to the describe payload that produced those results.

what_it_does: Removes the named objects and folders, after a recursive pre-check that warns about removing a whole project, and reports paths that fail to resolve.

decisions.label: a
decisions.why: Reusing the pre-check resolution would drop the second interactive prompt for an ambiguous name, because resolve_existing_path with allow_mult prompts in an interactive session and the main loop calls it again. The output and user interaction would change, and the saving is only a few API round trips.

what_it_does: Sets the current project and working folder after resolving the path and checking that the folder can be listed.

decisions.label: a
decisions.why: When the describe is moved into the branch that uses it, a failing describe in the skipped case would no longer exit with the describe error at line 737, so the error path and its message change, which breaks the same-output rule.

what_it_does: Describes a data object, execution or project named by a path or ID and prints the result in the chosen format.

decisions.label: a
decisions.why: The probe decides whether the project hint is sent, since ResourceNotFound omits the hint, other errors raise, and success adds it. Removing the probe changes behaviour for an inaccessible workspace, and a fallback path would need to match each exception path exactly, which is not shown.

what_it_does: Downloads the non-directory files of a database object, listing them first and writing each under the output path.

decisions.label: a
decisions.why: The debug calls format whole objects, including the full database file listing, before logging.debug discards them at the INFO level set by basicConfig. Switching these calls to lazy %s logging gives the same text when debug is on and skips the formatting otherwise, and the saving is CPU that scales with listing size, which is unmeasured because real listings are not in the repository.

what_it_does: Finds executions matching the query and prints each root with its retries and stage tree, optionally as JSON.

decisions.label: a
decisions.why: The roots mapping is an OrderedDict with one entry per root in a result page, so building a key list to test emptiness copies a few entries, which costs microseconds.

what_it_does: Builds the run request for an executable from the arguments, merges cloned and overriding system requirements, prints warnings, and submits the run.

decisions.label: a
decisions.why: The deep copy protects args.cloned_job_desc, because the system requirements objects share nested dicts with it and the merge calls at lines 3254, 3277 and 3278 update dicts in place. Removing the copy would alter the arguments, and the copy costs milliseconds.

decisions.label: b
decisions.why: Each workflow stage sends its own describe of its executable, so stages that share an executable ID repeat the same request. A memo keyed by that ID gives the same set of special access strings, because adding the same spec to a set is idempotent, and a failing describe still raises at its first occurrence. It runs only with an explicit priority of low or normal and without brief.

what_it_does: Produces tab-completion candidates for dx command words, paths, and app names for run, install and uninstall.

decisions.label: a
decisions.why: The class DXCLICompleter is never instantiated anywhere in the repository, since a grep finds only its definition, so no TAB press reaches this code and the energy claim has no caller to measure.

what_it_does: Opens an SSH session to a job by waiting for it to run, waiting for its host and host key, checking connectivity, and then launching ssh.

decisions.label: a
decisions.why: Both wait loops describe the job every second with no backoff. Describing on a doubling interval capped at 8 seconds, with the one-second sleep and the dot per iteration kept, cuts API requests to about one eighth after the first half minute. The trade-off is that a start or host key may be noticed up to 8 seconds late, and the printed output keeps the same form.

what_it_does: Tags files or a folder for archival or unarchival in one project, resolving the paths, optionally confirming, and sending the request.

decisions.label: a
decisions.why: Batching names by folder would replace k name-filtered searches with one folder search that returns every object in the folder, which can move more data, and the per-name pick prompts would have to be rebuilt on top of the batched result. The direction of the energy change is not established.

what_it_does: Looks up gene bin entries for a list of gene names in a platform manifest fetched with a dx cat subprocess, and returns the positions with strand removed.

decisions.label: a
decisions.why: Every call repeats a project describe, a platform file describe, a new dx cat process that downloads the manifest, and a JSON parse. A module-level cache keyed by project, reference, base path and manifest names, holding the parsed manifest and a per-call deep copy of each entry used, keeps the returned entries and the duplicate-gene KeyError identical. It goes stale only if the manifest is republished during one process, and the size of the saved download is unknown because the repository holds only 868-byte stubs.
